reviews.t: READ THIS: IT MAY HELP YOU!
reviews.x: Okay, I would recommend a different product: Elmer's glue. It comes in a bigger bottle, it is very cheap, and no need to ship it, as it can be found nearly anywhere. Elmer's glue works really well, so I just wanted to let you know. You may even have Elmer's at home already. I hope this helped you! 👍🏻
This is terrible! It's basically just watery elmers glue except that it never even dried! Better to just spend the extra buck for real liquid latex.

reviews.t: Dries in a few minutes time and works like it should
reviews.x: Works wonders. My husband and I were trying to guess what it's made of. From smell we guess pantiene conditioner, elmers glue, and some sort of latex. Dries in a few minutes time and works like it should, peels right off. Smells great! And arrived quickly, two weeks.

reviews.t: I paid for "CITY" brand, but received something called "WayGo."  This is false advertising.
reviews.x: I saw all the negative reviews, but thought I would try it anyway... less than $3 and free shipping wasn't going to break the bank.  However, all the negative reviews are accurate!  It takes a long time to dry (in the photo below, the picture was taken at about 5 minutes), and when it peels off it's inconsistent.  The first time it didn't come off all in one piece.  The second time it came off in one large piece and one tiny piece.  I would say it peels off like a thick layer of Elmer's glue pee

It does what it says but it seems to me that this is Elmers glue in a different bottle. First you have to put numerous coats on so it's not transparent. Then if you get it on your nail bed on accident it will peel the paint off the nail when you peel it off your cuticles Im gonna try Elmers glue and I'll let you know which one is better and if there's any difference in the 2

I wanted to try a peel off latex to use when doing my own manicures and gel nails. This is the first brand I've tried and it does what I need it to do! It's super easy to apply and easy to remove - even after being on my cuticles during uv/led light setting. My only complaint, and it is super minor at that, is that the latex isn't thick. I need to apply at least two coats, preferably three, for solid coverage. That's the ONLY remotely negative thing I can say and I will still buy it again! (My f
Love it!  My nails look much more professional.  The nail polishes stay within the edges where it belongs.  I get compliments on my nails all the time.
Not happy...wish it came with directions because idk what I'm doing wrong. Does not peel off as described...waste of money
Works as described.  Makes manicure look professional.  A must if you paint your own nails.

reviews.t: If I could give this less than one star, I would.
reviews.x: Children's craft glue works better and dries faster than this product. When it peels off it is very patchy, you can't peel it all in one piece as you can similar products I've tried, and if you get nail polish on it, it will peel you polish off as well. I received a different brand than advertised (CITY was advertised, but I received WayGo). This didn't bother me until I used it and discovered it was worthless. The only positive of this product is the smell, which is very pleasant.

This stuff does work. However, you need to apply quite a thick coat to get it to peel off all in one piece, and it takes quite a while to dry when you apply it thickly. A thin coat still does the job, it's just harder to get off. It does come off pretty easily with soap and water, though once your nails are dry.

It was a little too thin of liquid for me.I ended up ordering two different ones at the same time to compare. for the price it is a good brush and i suggest applying 2 coats and it will work great. The other one i paid a lot more for. so not bad for the price at all. Very good

reviews.t: Don't waste your money or your time
reviews.x: Not worth the money or the months ship time. I got it in the He nails months later. It is not labeled and I had no clue what it was. It came from some country in Asia. I was about to toss it out until I saw my order on here and when I tried to use it as directed it did not even come close to doing what it claims. Don't waste your money or your time. Hardly worth my time to give it a review but thought I'd try to help others save their money and avoid the disappointment

ordered in December arrived Jan 25th. Tried it out tonight, brush is large, hard to control, product is thick, like Elmer's glue, after  letting it dry and nail job was done it would not peal, I tried to wash it off with a nail brush, and warm water it wouldn't come off it didn't come off until I scrubbed it off with a wash cloth! don't waste your money! try Elmer's gel glue instead!

Did not enjoy this product whatsoever. It was too hard to apply on the cuticules and took too long to dry. It would also peel off my nailpolish along with it when I peeled them off. The only thing I liked about this priduct is the fact that it smelled really, really good.  PROS: Smells really good  CONS: Hard to apply Takes too long to ship  Peels off nailpolish

reviews.t: Meh - more reliable vendors and latex free options are out there
reviews.x: delivered broken, was very inexpensive add on shipped from China so replacement never happened.  Don't buy it - is latex based as well.  My suggestion, use elmers white glue, works the same, just put a tablespoons worth in a little cup add a cup drops of water to thin and use a small craft brush to paint it on, let dry, do nails, let dry and peel off.

reviews.t: The product smells great and works OKAY
reviews.x: The product smells great and works OKAY. The reason I gave it three stars was because you have to use A LOT of product  (4-6 coats per finger) for it to dry thick enough to peel off easily and in one clean sweep.
this product is not good ya it might dry fast but its probably just glue smells like it and feels like it i hope NO one gets this and waste your money i suggest you get simply peel

reviews.t: More like dried our Elmers glue
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:7956e0b683247003212df42936092744]] Finally arrived 5 weeks after I ordered two bottles, and its completely worthless. Neither bottle had any form of label attached and both are completely dried out and unusable. See pictures. Peel off liquid tape? More like dried out Elmers glue. I would not buy again, and its not even worth the effort of sending it back. Sounded like a great product, but don't waste your time or money on it.

Worse than Elmer's glue! I think by far this is a terrible product. Takes forever to dry. Shipped from China, so who knows whats really in this. And when you do peel this off, it can take some of your gel polish from nail off. Like what other reviewers have said, better off with Elmer's glue

Just get a better product or elmers glue. haven't been able to get it off my hands in the last two hours and have messed up two of my nails... pissed
Don't even waste your time!!! I couldn't even get it too peel off. Tried washing it off and it was just unpleasant. Q-tips work better

reviews.t: If i could give no stars i would
reviews.x: So got my item after almost 3 months its recorded that I didn't get it I did yesterday posted picture to verify purchase....I am pretty experience d with nail products this was intended to be a gift but wound up not giving it considering it took ALMOST 3 MONTHS to get and I wound up getting another gift for the person so I kept it and I tried it out today...its garbage. You have to cake it on for it to even partially peel off and u still have to scrub it off because if the area u cover isn't gop

I should read the reviews before I buy something.  Even something as cheap as this. Shipping was slow - 3 weeks - and then the product was disappointing. It definitely seems like it's Elmer's Glue in a nail polish bottle.  It is very slow to dry, and when it does finally dry, it's clear, and not very sturdy when I tried to peel it off, it stretched & broke, much like peeling dried Elmer's Glue off my hand when I was a kid. Plus, the packaging is an un-labeled frosted glass jar with a nail brush

claims.text: Several reviewers say the product resembles Elmer's glue, describing it as watery or thick like craft glue.
Many reviewers complain it takes a long time to dry, especially when applied in thick coats.
Some reviewers report it peels off patchily or removes nail polish along with it.
Several reviewers say it works as described and gives a professional-looking manicure.
Some reviewers received a different brand than advertised or experienced very long shipping.
